_meta.paper: Barndorff-Nielsen, O.E., Hansen, P.R., Lunde, A. & Shephard, N. (2008) 'Designing Realized Kernels to Measure the Ex Post Variation of Equity Prices in the Presence of Noise', Econometrica, 76(6), pp. 1481-1536
_meta.equation: Eq. (3.1): RK = sum_{h=-H}^{H} k(h/(H+1)) * gamma_hat_h, with flat-top Parzen kernel
_meta.bandwidth: H = ceil(n^{3/5}) is the plug-in bandwidth when noise ratio is unknown (c*xi^{4/5}=1 approximation)
_meta.tolerance: rel=0.30 for convergence tests (finite-sample kernel bias), exact for bandwidth formula

properties.noise_debiasing: With i.i.d. noise, RV is biased UP by 2*n*noise_var. RK removes this bias.
properties.no_noise_convergence: Without noise, RK converges to IV at rate n^{-1/5} (slower than RV's n^{-1/2} but unbiased under noise)
